'''Tish''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]<ref name="Total" /> who was based out of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="Total" /> during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> Captain Tish was skilled in combat as a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbineer]] and [[Pike/Legends|pikeman]].<ref name="Total" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tish.png|250px|thumb|Cut depiction of Captain Tish from ''Star Wars Galaxies'']]

Tish was listed in several reference guides for the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], including the [[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide|''Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide'']], and the [[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide'']]. In both of these reference guides, Tish was listed as a level 16 captain of the Royal Naboo Security Forces, and as a denizen of Naboo.<ref name="Total" /><ref name="Complete">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> The ''Total Experience'' guide listed Captain Tish as carbineer and pikeman,<ref name="Total" /> while the ''Complete Guide'' simply listed Tish's primary weapon as a carbine, without making any mention of pikeman skills.<ref name="Complete" /> Despite being listed in these reference guides, Tish is not definitively known to have appeared on the [[Star Wars video games|video game]]'s live servers as a proper [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]].<ref name="AED" /> The reference guides do not elaborate on Tish's [[Species/Legends|species]] or [[Gender/Legends|gender]], nor any quests Tish may have been associated with.<ref name="Total" /><ref name="Complete" /> Nevertheless, an emulated depiction pulled from this character's Interchange File Format reveals what he would have looked like if he were added to the game.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref>
